experiment: P00.4 Linux WPE Remote Web Inspector protocol session
scope: A standalone Flutter Linux/WPE Release probe used the WPE Remote Inspector HTTP endpoint and its multiplexed WebSocket target. This verifies a WPE Web Inspector Protocol command response, not Chrome DevTools Protocol or product integration.
protocolNote: The endpoint is a multiplexing target. Commands for a child page target must be nested in Target.sendMessageToTarget using the target ID announced by Target.targetCreated. Sending Runtime or Page commands directly to the outer endpoint returns a domain-not-found error.
limitations: This is Web Inspector Protocol, not Chrome DevTools Protocol; Linux CDP remains unsupported by the pinned Flutter plugin.
The Inspector frontend UI was not attached; only a protocol command session was exercised.
WEBKIT_DISABLE_SANDBOX_THIS_IS_DANGEROUS=1 and WEBKIT_DMABUF_RENDERER_DISABLE_GBM=1 were set for this Xvfb diagnostic run.
No WPE hardware GBM/DMABUF, production security configuration, Alula product integration, or docs/04 multi-round memory acceptance was demonstrated.
One standalone replay was performed; this does not establish cross-version or cross-host behavior.
